Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IGRUA Simulator Instructor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IGRUA Simulator Instructor recruitment is 23rd August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the maximum age limit for the Simulator Instructor post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Simulator Instructor post is 55 years as of 1st August 2026. There might be age relaxations applicable for certain categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Simulator Instructor role?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a current Commercial Pilot License (CPL) with Multi-Engine experience. Having a current CPL with AFIR is considered desirable for this position.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Simulator Instructor post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Simulator Instructor position at Indira Gandhi Rashtriya Uran Akademi (IGRUA).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Simulator Instructor position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Simulator Instructor post ranges from Rs. 40,000 to Rs. 41,800 per month, which includes a basic salary, transport allowance, and aviation allowance.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is through email. Candidates need to send their application along with required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the IGRUA Simulator Instructor recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Simulator Instructor post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Simulator Instructor post includes a Written Test, followed by an Interview, and finally Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Indira Gandhi Rashtriya Uran Akademi (IGRUA) located?
faq.answer: Indira Gandhi Rashtriya Uran Akademi (IGRUA) is located in Amethi, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 229302.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Simulator Instructor post at IGRUA is on a contractual basis.
